summary: VenHub Global, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a Nasdaq compliance notice. The letter confirmed that the company's common stock closing bid price was at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days, satisfying Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, etc.) is involved; the filing is a routine current report on a listing compliance matter.
